test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: S, U, B, J, E, C and T are sitting around a circular table facing the center (but not necessarily in the same order). C is sitting to the immediate right of T. U is an immediate neighbour of both T and E. Only one person is sitting between C and S when counted from the right of C. B is sitting to the immediate left of E. Who are the immediate neighbours of J?
solution:
Given:

S, U, B, J, E, C and T are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

C is sitting to the immediate right of T. Only one person is sitting between C and S when counted from the right of C.

U is an immediate neighbour of both T and E. B is sitting to the immediate left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c44638eab836a5a5cce88d6d803a59c2a385e8d9e1786f9f1bae1725b010e1f.png] 

Thus, S and C are immediate neighbours of J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
